title: Streaming On-Policy Distillation: Decoupling Three Clocks for Stage-Wise Supervision Consumption
abstract: arXiv:2611.22298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In on-policy distillation (OPD), response completion, supervision delivery, and parameter updates need not share the same granularity. We develop streaming OPD by decoupling these three clocks: a response repeatedly delivers newly generated segments while generation continues, retaining the full causal prefix at each delivery and computing loss only on new positions. A consumption protocol then organizes supervision budgets, position selection, staleness handling, and update scheduling, allowing control over quantity, coverage, and version lag across training stages. In GSM8K experiments distilling Qwen3-4B into Qwen3-0.6B with VERL, supervised-budget matching reduces the early gap between best test accuracies over seven common candidates from 4.55 to 2.42 points. Synchronous continuation from the same checkpoint reaches 73.39% best test accuracy over seven common candidates at u=384,...,576, versus 74.30% synchronous and 71.95% budget-m

translated_title: 流式在策略蒸馏：解耦三个时钟实现分阶段监督消费
translated_abstract: 在在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，响应完成、监督交付和参数更新不必共享相同的粒度。我们通过解耦这三个时钟来开发流式OPD：响应在生成持续进行的同时反复交付新生成的片段，每次交付时保留完整的因果前缀，并仅在新位置上计算损失。随后，一个消费协议组织监督预算、位置选择、陈旧性处理和更新调度，从而可以在训练各阶段对数量、覆盖范围和版本滞后进行控制。在使用VERL将Qwen3-4B蒸馏到Qwen3-0.6B的GSM8K实验中，监督预算匹配将在七个共同候选模型上最佳测试准确率的早期差距从4.55分降低到2.42分。从同一检查点同步继续训练，在u=384,...,576时，在七个共同候选模型上达到73.39%的最佳测试准确率，相比之下同步方法为74.30%，预算匹配方法为71.95%。
tldr: 该论文提出流式在策略蒸馏方法，通过解耦响应生成、监督交付和参数更新这三个时钟，实现分阶段灵活的监督消费控制，在GSM8K蒸馏实验中显著缩小了与同步方法的性能差距。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Streaming On-Policy Distillation, which decouples the three clocks of response completion, supervision delivery, and parameter updates to enable stage-wise control over supervision consumption, significantly narrowing the performance gap versus synchronous methods in GSM8K distillation experiments.
